# Agent Security Policy & Blast Radius Justification

To limit the blast radius of automated AI agents within this repository, specific capabilities have been restricted in sub-agent configurations.

- Bash: Denied to prevent execution of unvetted arbitrary system commands on host or containers.
- WebSearch: Denied to enforce offline spec-driven development and prevent prompt injection attacks.
- GitCommit: Denied to ensure that all git commits and history modifications remain under human control.
